summary: First testing pass on Ankita Sarkar retro-arcade portfolio. Verified all 10 requested features across backend (4 pytest tests) and frontend (Playwright on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844). All backend endpoints (/api/, /api/visit, /api/contact GET+POST, validation) pass. All frontend flows work: boot screen -> PRESS START, navbar players-online counter, 6 trophy cards unlock on scroll, minigame breakout starts/scores/dispatches game-over 'OUCH!' cheer to KawaiiBuddy, quest modal open+close-to-contact, contact form submit shows 'MESSAGE SENT!' cheer bubble, footer player count, mobile layout has no horizontal overflow and canvas fits width.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes email log message on failure only; consider structured logging. Non-blocking.
/api/visit inserts a new doc per call with no dedupe (no session/IP tracking) — 'online' can be inflated by refreshes. Product decision, not a bug.
No index on visits.ts field; count_documents with $gte will collection-scan as data grows. Add TTL index (e.g. expireAfterSeconds=300) to auto-purge old visits and keep collection small.
Contact endpoint has no rate limiting or captcha — potential email abuse vector via Emergent email proxy.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded in list_contact via projection — good.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed contact message inserted via pytest; a few /api/visit rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boot screen must be dismissed via [data-testid=press-start-button] on every load. Contact POST triggers real email — limit to 1 submission per run. Minigame game-over takes ~10s of idle time to lose all 3 lives. Trophy cards unlock 0.5-2s after scrolling into view. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py.
